description: This Java source file defines a Spring Framework condition class 'EnableFineractEventListenerCondition' which determines if certain event listeners should be enabled based on environment properties related to Fineract's modes (read, write, batch). It implements the 'Condition' interface to integrate with Spring's conditional bean creation mechanisms.

classes.name: EnableFineractEventListenerCondition
classes.description: A class implementing Spring's Condition interface to determine whether Fineract event listeners should be activated based on environment properties related to various operational modes.

methods.name: matches
methods.description: Overrides the 'matches' method to evaluate environment properties and determine if the event listeners should be enabled based on the logic for read, write, and batch modes.
